description.text: Probation officers and correctional treatment specialists check conditions, interview, record progress, and coordinate education and treatment resources in judicial or correctional institutions. See the United States O*NET 21-1092 tasks and 2025 wages, the BLS 2025–2035 employment projection, the Chinese community corrections system boundaries, occupational risks, and the fictional case exercises.

title.text: Probation officers and correctional treatment specialists

subject.name: Probation officers and correctional treatment specialists
subject.summary: Within the United States court or correctional system, probation officers and correctional treatment specialists check judicial conditions, interview supervisees, record compliance and rehabilitation needs, and coordinate education, employment, or treatment resources. Whether to recommend violation handling must be based on verifiable facts and institutional procedure; the statutory bodies and authorities for community corrections in China are confirmed separately under local law.
